nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a directed graph, let $B$ be one of the blocks returned by the strongly connected components algorithm on $G$, and let $m$ be a vertex of $B$. Then for every vertex $v$ of $G$, the vertices $m$ and $v$ are strongly connected (each is reachable from the other) if and only if $v$ lies in $B$.
nodes.title: Each computed component is a full mutual-reachability class

nodes.summary: In a directed graph $G$, a list $S$ of vertices reaches a list $T$ of vertices when some vertex of $S$ reaches some vertex of $T$ by a directed path in $G$, possibly of length zero.
nodes.title: Reachability between components

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a directed graph and let $S$ and $T$ be blocks returned by the strongly connected components algorithm on $G$. If some vertex of $S$ reaches some vertex of $T$ and some vertex of $T$ reaches some vertex of $S$, then $S = T$.
nodes.title: The condensation of the computed components is acyclic

nodes.summary: For every directed graph $G$, the list of blocks returned by the strongly connected components algorithm on $G$ is an SCC partition of $G$: every block is nonempty and contains no vertex twice, blocks at different positions of the list are disjoint, every vertex of $G$ lies in some block, two vertices lie in a common block exactly when they are strongly connected, and for every vertex $m$ of a block $B$ and every…
nodes.title: The computed components form the SCC partition

nodes.summary: For every directed graph $G$, each block returned by the strongly connected components algorithm on $G$ contains no vertex more than once.
nodes.title: Computed components have no repeated vertices

nodes.summary: For every directed graph $G$, each block returned by the strongly connected components algorithm on $G$ contains at least one vertex.
nodes.title: Computed components are nonempty

nodes.summary: For every directed graph $G$, any two blocks at different positions of the list returned by the strongly connected components algorithm on $G$ have no vertex in common.
nodes.title: Computed components are pairwise disjoint

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a directed graph and let $v_1, \dots, v_n$ be its vertices in decreasing order of finishing time in a depth-first search of the whole graph that takes its roots in the vertex order of $G$. For each $i$, let $C_i$ be the list of those $v_j$, in increasing order of $j$, such that $v_i$ and $v_j$ are strongly connected (tested by two depth-first searches). The output is the list $C_1, \dots, C_n$ with…
nodes.title: Strongly connected components algorithm

nodes.summary: A list $\mathcal{B}$ of vertex lists of a directed graph $G$ has an acyclic condensation when, for all $S, T \in \mathcal{B}$, if some vertex of $S$ reaches some vertex of $T$ in $G$ and some vertex of $T$ reaches some vertex of $S$, then $S = T$. That is, reachability between the blocks is antisymmetric.
nodes.title: Acyclic condensation

nodes.summary: A list $\mathcal{B}$ of vertex lists is an SCC partition of a directed graph $G$ when every block of $\mathcal{B}$ is nonempty and contains no vertex twice, blocks at different positions of $\mathcal{B}$ are disjoint, a vertex lies in some block exactly when it is a vertex of $G$, two vertices lie in a common block exactly when they are strongly connected (each is reachable from the other), and for every block $B$,…
nodes.title: SCC partition

nodes.summary: For a directed graph $G$ and a vertex $v$, $v$ belongs to some block of the computed strongly connected components of $G$ if and only if $v$ occurs in the vertex enumeration of $G$.
nodes.title: The computed components cover the vertex list

nodes.summary: For a directed graph $G$ and vertices $u$ and $v$, the executable mutual-reachability test on $u$ and $v$ returns true if and only if $u$ and $v$ are strongly connected in $G$.
nodes.title: The mutual-reachability test is correct

nodes.summary: For a directed graph $G$ and vertices $u$ and $v$, the test returns true exactly when $v$ occurs in the preorder of the depth-first search of $G$ from the single root $u$, and $u$ occurs in the preorder of the depth-first search of $G$ from the single root $v$.
nodes.title: Executable mutual-reachability test

nodes.summary: For a directed graph $G$ and vertices $u$ and $v$, some block of the computed strongly connected components of $G$ contains both $u$ and $v$ if and only if $u$ and $v$ are strongly connected in $G$.
nodes.title: Vertices share a computed component exactly when strongly connected

nodes.summary: In a directed graph $G$, every vertex is strongly connected to itself.
nodes.title: Strong connectivity is reflexive

nodes.summary: For a directed graph $G$, the relation on the vertices of $G$ that holds between $u$ and $v$ exactly when $u$ and $v$ are strongly connected in $G$, packaged as an equivalence relation.
nodes.title: Strong connectivity as an equivalence relation

nodes.summary: In a directed adjacency graph $G$, vertices $u$ and $v$ are strongly connected when $v$ is reachable from $u$ and $u$ is reachable from $v$ in $G$.
nodes.title: Strongly connected vertices

nodes.summary: In a directed graph $G$, if $u$ is strongly connected to $v$, then $v$ is strongly connected to $u$.
nodes.title: Strong connectivity is symmetric

nodes.summary: In a directed graph $G$, if $u$ is strongly connected to $v$ and $v$ is strongly connected to $w$, then $u$ is strongly connected to $w$.
nodes.title: Strong connectivity is transitive

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
